description: Eighteen patches for the Vesper and Lantern synthesizers, in six banks: slow coastal pads, sub-heavy basses, singing leads, intimate rooms, mechanical sequences and late-night keys. Every patch follows halcyon-patch/2.1.

patches.name: Paper Organ
patches.notes: A looping multi-segment envelope makes it breathe on its own; hold one key.
